festivals.name: Homowo Festival
festivals.description: Harvest festival meaning 'hooting at hunger' with street processions, drumming, and dancing
traveler_tips: Arrive early for a good spot

festivals.name: Aboakyer Festival
festivals.description: Animal hunting festival where groups compete to catch a live antelope
traveler_tips: Keep a safe distance from the hunt

festivals.name: Odwira Festival
festivals.description: Purification and harvest festival with durbar of chiefs, drumming, and dancing
traveler_tips: The grand durbar on Saturday features spectacular kente and gold regalia

festivals.name: Panafest
festivals.description: Pan-African Historical Theatre Festival celebrating African culture and diaspora heritage

festivals.name: Chale Wote Street Art Festival
festivals.description: Alternative street art, music, and performance festival

festivals.name: Akwasidae
festivals.description: Sacred Asante celebration honoring the Golden Stool with a durbar at Manhyia Palace

festivals.name: Hogbetsotso Festival
festivals.description: Festival of Exodus commemorating the Ewe migration from Notsie
traveler_tips: Best experienced with a local guide
